Check that finding against the supplied sources, distinguish already handled read-time failures, and propose a repair and observable tests, or explain why evidence is insufficient. Propose observable failure-injection and successful-read checks without adding tools or widening filesystem access. A no-repair or evidence-insufficient conclusion still requires at least one proposed check.
State remaining uncertainties and distinguish source inspection from the host-reported synthetic probe. Do not claim tests or proposed code were executed.
boundaries: Proposal only. Never execute code, shell commands, or patches.
Preserve the talk runner's existing successful read_room behavior and CLI exit semantics.
No MCP, deployment, Puppy Linux integration, additional tools, or provider changes.
